scenario.topic: Agree on the highlight reel song for the season finale video

options.name: Upbeat Indie Pop Track
options.upside: Matches the video length perfectly and maintains an energetic vibe.
options.concern: May feel generic to some viewers due to common indie pop elements.

options.name: Instrumental Electronic Groove
options.upside: Provides a modern and dynamic sound that complements fast-paced footage.
options.concern: Requires a group license fee which may impact budget.

options.name: Acoustic Folk Melody
options.upside: Offers a warm and authentic tone that highlights emotional moments.
options.concern: Slower tempo might reduce energy in some highlight scenes.

options.upside: Delivers an intense and powerful atmosphere suited for climactic scenes.
options.concern: License restrictions limit use to this project only.

shared_context: The group of 7 is selecting a song for the season finale highlight reel video. The song must fit a 3-minute video, be royalty-free or licensed for group use, and match the energetic tone of the season.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a music producer who values modern and dynamic soundscapes.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the song complements fast-paced footage and energizes viewers.

A.reason_for: Matches the video length perfectly and has an energetic vibe.
A.reason_against: Feels less dynamic compared to electronic options.

B.reason_for: Provides a modern and dynamic sound ideal for fast-paced footage.

C.reason_for: Warm tone is nice but tempo is too slow for energy needed.
C.reason_against: Slower tempo might reduce energy in highlight scenes.

D.reason_for: Intense and powerful, good for climactic moments.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a budget-conscious editor who prefers straightforward choices.
personas.private_goal: Avoid costly licenses and keep the selection simple.

A.reason_for: Royalty-free and fits video length perfectly.

B.reason_against: License fee is a budget concern.

C.reason_for: Royalty-free and warm tone is a plus.

D.reason_against: License restrictions and cost make it impractical.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a creative director who values intensity and emotional impact.
personas.private_goal: Choose a song that delivers a powerful and memorable finale.

A.reason_against: Feels too generic for a climactic finale.

B.reason_for: Modern and dynamic, supports energy well.

C.reason_against: Too slow and less intense for finale energy.

D.reason_for: Intense and powerful, perfect for climactic scenes.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a storyteller who prefers warm and emotional tones.
personas.private_goal: Highlight emotional moments with a genuine and heartfelt song.

C.reason_for: Warm and authentic tone highlights emotion well.

D.reason_for: Intense mood is good but less warm.
D.reason_against: License restrictions and less emotional warmth.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a pragmatic project manager focused on quality and licensing.
personas.private_goal: Select a licensed track that balances quality and usability.

B.reason_for: Modern, dynamic, and licensed for group use.

C.reason_for: Warm tone is nice but tempo is slow.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a quiet but thoughtful editor who values authenticity.
personas.private_goal: Choose a song that feels genuine and fits the mood naturally.

C.reason_for: Warm and authentic tone matches emotional highlights.

D.reason_against: License restrictions and less natural feel.

personas.name: Ivy
personas.background: Ivy is a direct and passionate editor who prioritizes intensity.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the finale has a strong, memorable impact.

A.reason_against: Not intense enough for finale impact.

B.reason_for: Dynamic and modern sound supports energy.

C.reason_for: Warm tone is nice but tempo too slow.
C.reason_against: Less intense for a strong finale.

D.reason_for: Intense and powerful, perfect for climactic scenes.
